reason: Both supplied recovery suffixes begin after a failed open-door attempt (feedback 'The door is not open.') and the observed recovery proceeds by moving to a different room rather than re-issuing the same open action. The trigger is restricted to explicit closed-door state and the exact failure feedback to avoid blanket vetoes and preserve legitimate waiting/reversal.

rule.invalidation: Invalidate when target_door_state is unknown, when last_feedback differs, or when the action target is not a door.
rule.protected_property: Avoid repeating an open-door action on a door that was just reported as not open, since the recovery suffix shows the agent instead proceeds to a different reachable location.
rule.scope: Door-opening actions in rooms where the target door is explicitly described as closed in the current look.
